caseName: National Psychological Ass'n for Psychoanalysis, Inc. v. University of New York
caseNameFull: NATIONAL PSYCHOLOGICAL ASSOCIATION FOR PSYCHOANALYSIS, INC. v. UNIVERSITY OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK
attorneys: Lyman Stansky for appellants., Louis J. Lejkowitz, Attorney General of New York, and Samuel A. Hirshowitz and Philip Watson, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.
